hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.mjs|*.json|*.md|*.yml|*.yaml|*.css|*.html) npx prettier --write "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1;; esac; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.mjs) out=$(npx oxlint --format=unix "$f" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$out" ]; then echo "$out" >&2; exit 2; fi;; esac
